entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
I need to return the VeloBand Pulse I bought.
Okay, I can certainly look into that for you. I've pulled up your account. I see the VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor was delivered about 18 days ago, on December 17th. Is that correct?
If that's what it says. Yes.

Got it. So, just for your awareness, the VeloBand Pulse has a specific 10-day return policy due to hygiene protocols. It looks like we're a bit outside that window. To understand how I can best help, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
I was a little busy to worry about your 10-day policy. There was an emergency.
I'm very sorry to hear that. I hope everything is alright now. We do have exceptions for certain life events. Could you tell me a bit more about what happened?
I was in the hospital. I had to have emergency surgery. I wasn't exactly checking my calendar to return a fitness tracker.

Thank you so much for sharing that, and I truly apologize you had to go through that. That absolutely qualifies for an exception, no question about it. We can process a full refund for you as a one-time courtesy given the circumstances. I'm overriding the policy now.

I've just approved the return in our system. I'm sending a prepaid return label to the email address on file. You should see it within the next 10 minutes. Just pack the VeloBand back in its box, attach the label, and drop it in the mail. Once our warehouse receives it, you'll see a full refund to your original payment method within 3 to 5 business days.
Is there anything else at all I can assist you with today?
Alright. Well, thank you again for your patience. I hope things are looking up for you. Have a good rest of your day.
